|events=[[Riegenn Hetuu]] and his [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|Hutt client]] both [[Death/Legends|die]]<ref name="TORCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}}</ref>}}
'''3743 BBY''', or '''3743 Before the Battle of Yavin''',<ref name="Time">The Prologue of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/1|here]]. As {{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}} is acquired during the Prologue on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and states that [[Riegenn Hetuu]] and his [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|client's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] occurred a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] ago, they must have died in what corresponds per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3743 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], or 3743 Before the Battle of Yavin.</ref> was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> It fell within the [[Inter-Sith Wars period|period]] of [[Time/Legends|time]] between the [[Battle of Rakata Prime|end]] of the [[Old Sith Wars]] in [[3956 BBY]] and the beginning of the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]].<ref name="Era" />

In 3743 BBY, the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Riegenn Hetuu]] was commissioned by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|client]] to capture a live [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]] for a gala celebration. Although Hetuu was successful in capturing and containing the [[Gender/Legends|queen]] in the cargo bay of his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], he did not account for the queen's ability to [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduce]], and when the cargo bay was accessed upon the hunter's meeting with the client on<ref name="TORCodex" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planet">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], approximately four hundred newly-[[Egg/Legends|hatched]] k'lor'slugs were released, [[Death/Legends|killing]] and [[Diet/Legends|consuming]] both Hetuu and the Hutt. The Hutt's death wails were enshrined in the phrase "a Hutt's cry," which was used to describe the cries of newly-hatched k'lor'slugs. The phrase would still be in use a [[3643 BBY|century]] later.<ref name="TORCodex" />

==Behind the scenes==
3743 BBY was indirectly mentioned in the Codex entry for the k'lor'slug in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TORCodex" />
